summary: Iteration 48 — Tested Bug A (buy-flow safety wrap), Bug C (orphan adoption), and UI glow fixes. All backend tests pass (10/10). Bug A + Bug C fully verified. UI glow: 'clear-on-nav-click' works correctly (glow removed immediately, not after 6s). However, the 'no-self-glow' guard has a REAL BUG: it does not recognize the Trade tab because Trade's route is /modules/trade, not /trade — so the guard's split('/')[0] extracts 'modules' instead of 'trade' and the glow IS still applied when user is already on Trade. This is the exact scenario the fix was supposed to prevent.

ui_bugs.issue: Self-glow guard fails for the Trade tab. Route path is '/modules/trade' but code does pathname.split('/')[0] which yields 'modules'. wantedTab='trade' -> mismatch -> guard does NOT return early -> Trade nav glows even though user is already on /modules/trade. Reproduced: navigate to /modules/trade (via clicking sidebar Trade item) and dispatch window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('spark:nav-glow',{detail:{targetId:'nav-trade'}})) -> nav-trade gets spark-nav-glow class (expected: NOT get class).

action_items: Fix the self-glow guard in /app/frontend/src/components/layout/MainLayout.js (~line 164). Instead of `pathname.split('/')[0]`, match against the actual nav-item path or normalise by using the last path segment. Suggested fix: derive currentPage from the item registry, e.g. iterate navigationConfig items, find item.path that matches window.location.pathname startsWith, and compare item.id to wantedTab. Or simpler: `if (window.location.pathname.endsWith('/' + wantedTab)) return;` which correctly handles /modules/trade -> 'trade'. Retest all nav routes (dashboard, chat, trade, wallet, etc.) after fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Route mismatch — sidebar item id 'nav-trade' but the actual path is '/modules/trade'. The self-glow guard assumes 1:1 mapping between the first path segment and nav item id, which is not the case for MODULES-section items (trade, wallet, winkel, boekhouding, etc.). Guard is silently broken for the entire MODULES section.
monitor.py is now 1715 lines — consider splitting the BUY-flow (lines ~1180-1400), adoption logic (~937-1050), and event-notification helpers into separate modules for maintainability.
Bug A fix writes event_notifications.json with slicing existing[-200:] which is good (bounded growth). Consider same bound on ui_refresh_trigger.json (it is overwritten each time, so fine).

Bug C orphan-adoption fetches tickers once per cycle for orphan markets — good. But there is no dedup with the main _run_market_cycle ticker call; if user adds an orphan market to _markets later, they get processed twice in the same cycle. Low priority.

The remaining fix needed is only the self-glow guard path parsing for /modules/* routes. After main agent patches MainLayout.js, retest by: 1) login Willem/Appelsap, 2) click Trade sidebar (goes to /modules/trade), 3) evaluate `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('spark:nav-glow',{detail:{targetId:'nav-trade'}}))`, 4) confirm nav-trade does NOT have class spark-nav-glow.
rca_of_the_issue: Self-glow guard uses window.location.pathname.replace(/^\/+/, '').split('/')[0] to get currentPage. On /modules/trade this returns 'modules', not 'trade'. The comparison `currentPage === wantedTab` ('modules' === 'trade') is false so the guard doesn't return early and glow is applied. Fix: compare against a normalised value (e.g. last segment: pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop()) OR reverse-lookup the nav item whose path matches pathname and compare its id to targetId.
